name: B39
what: The frozen R39 baseline (doc/r40_tasks_and_acceptance.md sec 3.1): R39's signed-off software, its final board image and configuration, on the CPU migration path (torch CPU tensors -> Inductor cpu_backend="triton" -> tnca).

inductor.source: python/tnca/inductor.py configure(); recorded per record in platform.inductor

runtime.path: CPU tensors -> Inductor cpu_backend="triton" -> tnca driver; every launch uploads its argument storages and downloads them

defaults.knobs_note: The board records set TNCA_RCTX_ROLES=0 explicitly (--set), equal to the default; a comparison against B39 declares it if the other side leaves it unset.

image.name: u280_r39h

memory.note: rtl/fpga/tnca_fpga_mem.v; one core, one 8 B/cycle data port

image.clock_measured_how: flow/fpga/measure_clock.py: device cycles over host-timed spin kernels, two runs

toolchain.note: R40 is locked to torch 2.14.0 and Triton 3.8.0 (doc sec R40-00); an upgrade is its own compatibility ablation. The extension APIs actually present are in spec/r40/api_lock.json.

timing.note: protocol 1: the sum over the call's launches of launch_accept_to_core_idle in device cycles; programs of a grid run one after another; one deterministic run per point (the first call); host transfers excluded. Seconds = cycles / clock_hz.

boundaries.device: time.device, time.per_launch[].cycles: launch accepted -> core idle
boundaries.host_transfer: host.transfer_s: every launch's upload + download (first call)
boundaries.host_wall: host.wall_s: the first call -- Dynamo, Inductor, Triton and the tnca lowering, then the launches; compile time = wall_s - transfer_s - device seconds - dispatch, not separately recorded in protocol 1
boundaries.process: host.process_s: the child process, including the CPU reference

open_items.title: B4: llama_decode tiny is 2 cycles longer on the board after gpt2_block
open_items.owner: R40-00 (investigation), RTL owner of the core
blocks: B4 on the on-chip-RAM image (doc sec 3.4: stays open, not closed by HBM rules)
does_not_block: any R40 performance gate (0.0004 % of the point)
evidence: board u280_r39h: 545162 alone (twice); 545164 after gpt2_block, and on every later run until the device state changes (after llama_decode, after add, alone again)
one kernel differs: triton_poi_fused__unsafe_view_neg_split_transpose_view_3, grid 2, 161 -> 162 cycles at both of its launches; the other 40 launches identical
not memory next to the buffers: 4 KiB guards filled 0xFF and 0x00 both give 545164, results identical
a one-session simulation of gpt2_block then llama_decode twice gives 545162 every time (buffers at other addresses than a fresh process on the board)
open_items.next: find the state a launch does not reset: rerun the one kernel on the board after gpt2_block with the counters per context, and in simulation with the board's buffer addresses

open_items.title: softmax fp16 tiny is faster with any one of four timing switches off
open_items.owner: R40-07 (pipeline and matrix: the timing model is updated there)
does_not_block: the point is still 4.36x the R39-00 baseline
evidence: full v4: 4489 cycles; FE_NOBUBBLE off: 3965; FPU_OVERLAP, VRF_BYPASS or RCTX_SWITCH off also 2-12 % faster

open_items.title: fp32 matmul small/medium and conv2d fp32 0.7-1.4 % slower on u280_r39h than u280_r39f
